name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana: LPG connection for eligible households
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
source_note: ILLUSTRATIVE SEED DATA. Criteria are simplified for the prototype and are not a substitute for the official scheme guidelines; replace before any real use.

criteria.clause_text: The connection is issued in the name of an adult woman of the household.
The applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
The household must hold a BPL or equivalent category card.
